task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary with 1-2 sentences and fewer than 40 words.
Write a summary of about 3 sentences and around 60-70 words.
Write a detailed summary with 5 or more sentences and over 100 words.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수로 나타내는 문장 복잡도입니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with fewer than 15 words each.
Use longer, more complex sentences averaging about 20-25 words.

axes.name: stance_directness
axes.description: 서술 태도에서 직접적이고 단정적인 표현과 완곡한 표현의 정도입니다.

values.instruction: Include cautious or hedging language to soften statements.
Make clear, direct statements with minimal hedging.
Avoid using many numerals; use mostly words instead.
Include some numerals naturally when relevant.
Use many numerals to provide detailed quantitative information.
